clue.text: Replant or clip if very productive

indicators.note: to replant is to set out again in new places, so the letters of the words before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: A gardener is told that replanting or pruning will make the plant yield heavily.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something prolific turns out a great deal, as a fruitful tree or a busy author does.

clue.text: Poor golfer perhaps that still gets down the hole

definitions.meaning: sporting slang for a weak, unskilled player, in golf or cricket

definitions.text: that still gets down the hole
definitions.meaning: the burrowing animal vanishes into its warren, as a good golf shot sinks into the cup

explanation.surface: A hopeless golfer who somehow still manages to sink the ball.
explanation.definitionFit: Sporting slang calls an inept player by the name of the timid burrowing animal, which also disappears down holes.

clue.text: He composed a catalogue, we hear

indicators.note: what we hear is spoken, so the word given by the catalogue is matched by its pronunciation

parts.note: a catalogue is a list of items

explanation.surface: A composer is said to have produced a catalogue of his works.
explanation.walkthrough: Franz Liszt was the Hungarian composer and pianist; his name is pronounced like the word for a catalogue.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Liszt was a nineteenth-century Hungarian composer, so he is one who composed.

clue.text: Van driver's warning on promenade

parts.note: a golfer who drives the ball shouts fore to warn anyone in its path
a seaside promenade is the front, as in seafront

explanation.surface: A van driver sounds a warning while driving along the seaside promenade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Van' looks like a vehicle, but here it is short for vanguard; the 'driver' is a golfer teeing off.
explanation.definitionFit: Van, short for vanguard, means the leading position, the very front of a movement or army.

clue.text: Protective garment put right in wrong closet

indicators.note: the letter for right is placed in the middle of the reworked letters
the word closet put wrong, out of its proper order, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone puts a piece of protective clothing away properly after it was left in the wrong cupboard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrong' turns CLOSET into COSLET, and 'in' places R inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Historical term: a corslet is a piece of body armour covering the trunk, a protective garment.

clue.text: Two firms after gold backing for decoration

indicators.note: the two firms come after the reversed gold in the answer
backing means going backwards, so the word for gold is read in reverse

parts.note: or is the heraldic word for gold
CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm; two of them give COCO

explanation.surface: Two companies come in after a gold investor to fund some decoration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns OR, heraldic gold, into RO.
explanation.definitionFit: Rococo is an ornate eighteenth-century style of ornament, so the word names a kind of decoration.

clue.text: Wandering dog?

parts.note: a traditional name for a pet dog, which also describes someone who roams about

explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: the classic dog's name also means a roamer, so it fits a dog given to wandering.

clue.text: Found out people's feelings involving sand and caves

indicators.note: to involve is literally to roll up together, so the letters of the two words are tangled into a new order

explanation.surface: A pollster sounds out opinion among people who live by beaches and caves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and' simply links the two pieces of fodder; only SAND and CAVES are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to canvass is to seek opinions or votes, so having canvassed is having found out what people feel.

clue.text: Motive and style that one may use for walking across water

definitions.text: that one may use for walking across water

parts.note: a motive is a cause or reason for doing something
a style is a way or manner of doing things

explanation.surface: Someone weighs up the motive and manner of a person who walks on water.
explanation.definitionFit: A causeway is a raised road or path across marshland or water, for crossing it on foot.

clue.text: He reviles a blockhead employer

parts.note: read as the head of the word block, its first letter B
one who employs or uses something is a user

explanation.surface: A worker complains that a stupid boss is always insulting him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blockhead' seems to be an insult, but it is split as block's head, giving B.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: one who reviles another heaps insults on them, which is what a verbal abuser does.

clue.text: Very hungry bird comes to love us

parts.note: the raven is a large black bird of the crow family
love means nil in tennis scoring, written as O

explanation.surface: A starving bird comes to us looking for affection.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: ravenous means extremely hungry, ready to eat greedily.

clue.text: Film Ruth, merry and uproarious

indicators.note: uproarious means wild and disorderly, so the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A director is told to film an actress named Ruth in a merry, riotous scene.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: full of mirth means full of laughter and gaiety, which is to be merry.

clue.text: Are in debt, but managed to bring up the children

definitions.text: managed to bring up the children

indicators.note: the clue's word are is placed in the colour that stands for debt

parts.note: being in debt is being in the red, so red stands for debt

explanation.surface: A couple are in debt, but they still managed to raise their family.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to rear children is to raise them, so having managed to bring them up is to have reared them.

clue.text: Travelling light?

parts.note: the phrase for packing few belongings is read literally as a light that moves across the night sky

explanation.definitionFit: Description: a meteor appears as a streak of light flying across the sky, literally light that travels.

clue.text: A form of art

parts.note: an art form, read also as art that gives form, the shaping of solid material

explanation.definitionFit: Example: carving or modelling three-dimensional figures is an art whose whole business is giving shape.

clue.text: The opposite of all dressed up and nowhere to go

definitions.text: The opposite of all dressed up and nowhere to go

parts.words: The opposite of all dressed up and nowhere to go
parts.note: the opposite of being fully dressed is being naked; the opposite of nowhere to go is having no engagements in the diary

explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: the phrase means both being naked and having no plans, each the reverse of half the saying.

clue.text: Broken fences or implements

indicators.note: fences that are broken lie in pieces, so the letters of the words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Broken fences, or else garden tools, lie around a field.
explanation.walkthrough: 'implements' looks like a noun for tools, but it is the verb meaning carries out.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to implement a rule is to put it into effect, which is what one who enforces it does.

clue.text: Poorly educated and not prepared to grow crops

definitions.meaning: lacking cultivation of the mind, so unrefined and unschooled
land that has not been ploughed or tilled for farming

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both unrefined in mind and, of soil, never tilled for farming.

clue.text: Wild flower absorbs nitrogen

indicators.note: the flower absorbs, taking inside it, the symbol for nitrogen

parts.note: the violet is a small purple flower
N is the chemical symbol for nitrogen

explanation.surface: A wild flower draws nitrogen from the soil, as plants do.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wild' sits beside 'flower' as if describing it, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: wild in the sense of fierce, uncontrolled and rough, as a violent storm is.

clue.text: Rum loo embellished with gilt decoration

indicators.note: something embellished has been dressed up and altered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A strange toilet has been decorated with gold leaf.
explanation.walkthrough: LOO is British slang for a toilet.
explanation.definitionFit: Ormolu is gilded bronze or brass used to ornament furniture and clocks, so it is gilt decoration.

clue.text: It carries food for an animal — flea, maybe?

definitions.text: It carries food for an animal
definitions.meaning: a funnel-shaped container that feeds grain or fodder to livestock
a flea is an example of a creature that hops

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a feed bin that dispenses fodder and any jumping creature such as a flea.

clue.text: Respond — to an encore call?

definitions.meaning: to respond is to answer or behave in reply to something
an encore calls on a performer to act again

explanation.definitionFit: The word means to respond, and split in two it means to perform again, as an encore demands.

clue.text: Newspaper's deadline?

parts.note: a newspaper deadline is a time for copy, read instead as the lines printed about someone dead

explanation.definitionFit: Pun: a newspaper notice of someone's death is literally the paper's lines about the dead.

clue.text: It's very much used as a prefix

definitions.text: It's very much used as a prefix

parts.words: It's very much used as a prefix
parts.note: a Latin element meaning beyond or extremely, placed before words such as violet or modern to mean beyond the usual

explanation.definitionFit: Description: this Latin prefix means extremely, so it is a prefix meaning very much, and a very common one.

clue.text: Account presented to member of clergy is absolutely correct

parts.note: a curate is an assistant priest in the Church of England

explanation.surface: A bookkeeper hands the accounts to a vicar, who finds them perfectly right.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: exactly right and free from error, with no mistakes at all.

clue.text: Is elected to boards

definitions.meaning: to get on a committee is to win a place on it
to board a bus or train is to climb aboard it

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both winning a seat on a body and climbing onto a vehicle.

clue.text: A bouquet for mounting

parts.note: a bouquet is the scent or aroma of a wine

explanation.surface: A bunch of flowers is held up ready to be mounted for display.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bouquet' looks like a bunch of flowers, but it is the aroma of a wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: mounting a hill is climbing it, and a climb up is the noun for that act.

clue.text: Mythical king who never quite got what he wanted

definitions.text: Mythical king who never quite got what he wanted

parts.words: Mythical king who never quite got what he wanted
parts.note: the Greek king punished in the underworld by fruit and water that always moved just out of reach

explanation.definitionFit: Greek myth: this king stood in water under fruit trees, but both receded whenever he reached, giving us the verb tantalise.
